notes: All four files are 1920x1080 yuv420p h264_videotoolbox ~25M target, aac audio, 16:9 full frame (content x 0-1920), no crop. No channel logos/bugs found: temporal-median edge maps (60 samples per source) showed no static corner overlays, so removelogo was not applied. Times below are seconds in the normalized footage files. 'lap' = median Laplacian variance at 1080p over 5 samples; it is NOT comparable across sources (clip 4 is AI-upscaled/over-sharpened so it scores 270-700, clean HD cels score 2-26), so the sharp/ok/soft label is from reading full-res frames, with lap kept for reference. Not found in clean HD: the empty Academy swing (clip 3 28.86-33.78 is sunset playground equipment, not the swing) and Naruto eating alone. Rejected: Crunchyroll Boruto clips (burned-in subtitles, mostly adult Naruto), Shippuden 478 upload 0_krBPTjC80 (burned subtitles), Yahwel compilation wKcV9xHtCwM (corner logo + subtitles + dust overlay), Real Shinobi recaps (captions + logo + narration).

clips.source_note: raw clip pack 'Twixtor Naruto kids 4k no cc' (Headman), 3840x2160 30/1. Change cadence = runs of 4 then a held frame (24->30 pulldown pattern), so ffmpeg decimate removed 1 in 5 -> 24/1 (1181 frames). Shippuden-era HD kid Naruto, very clean.
clips.quality: sharp (4K source downscaled; crisp lines verified on frames at 20s and 25s)

clips.source_note: 'free kid naruto sad clips twixtor + time remap' (_xTwixtor), 1920x1080 30/1, time-remapped/interpolated (long runs of unique frames), kept at native 30/1. Black dips at ~5.9-6.1, ~11.97-12.2, ~21.7-21.93 and after 30.8.
clips.quality: ok (clean 1080 lines, no text; some interpolation ghosting on fast moves)

clips.source_note: compilation 'Naruto's Childhood Story' 720p 29.97; cut src 25-60 (-> 0-35) and src 340-372 (-> 35-67), decimate -> 24000/1001, lanczos upscale to 1080.
clips.quality: soft (720p upscale with compression; 35-67 is SD classic footage and blurrier)

clips.source_note: 'Free Kid Naruto Twixtor clips for Edits (UHD)' (ZENIN), 2560x1440 30/1, interpolated slow-mo of classic-era goggles Naruto (prank days) + genin shots, AI-upscaled; scaled to 1080, kept native 30/1.

scene_cuts.method: ffmpeg select gt(scene,0.25) and gt(scene,0.35); lists agree except extra 0.25-only hits (c2 19.00, c3 4.30, c4 13.17/35.53)
